checks.evidence: Exactly E1-E4 are represented, and no paper-facing E5 is present.
Every core experiment row has primary experiment, oracle, baselines, metrics, success criterion, failure interpretation, scope, target, and sources.
Primary experiments are named for all E1-E4 and are not chronological run lists.
E2 includes the required baselines and localization/ranking metrics.
The current baseline is fixed-session drilldown as a span-tree proxy; real span-tree imports remain future work.
Query-aware policies are scoped as task-query tuning heuristics rather than a universal label-free ranker.
R358 is scoped to supervised held-out boundary-derived fields, not automatic boundary discovery.
E3 includes executable profile-spec patches and the OSWorld-Human boundary-field ablation.
Metric, action-transfer, and boundary-field counterpoints remain visible.
R363 provides five non-flamegraph-only paper views for E2/E3 plus oracle depth.
R360/R361/R363 pass, R352 is level_4, and R357 has 4/4 accepts with 0 blockers.
R338/R352/R356/R357/R359/R360/R363 are treated as artifact and claim-hygiene gates, not empirical profiler accuracy evidence.
Operation/operation-stack remain the only profiler abstractions, and the no-new-data policy is visible.
All source artifacts are tracked; current paper/docs may be dirty while this audit is being generated.

claim: E1-E4 are substantial reviewer-facing experiments rather than a chronological run list

sufficiency_rows.baselines: Dataset-native stacks, no-map folding, fixed-session stacks, profile-spec replay, and direct operation-file versus standard-trace import/export.
sufficiency_rows.claim_gate_decision: Supported as operation/operation-stack coverage and configurability, not a new trace ecosystem compatibility claim.
sufficiency_rows.claim_test: Can the same operation layer be folded recursively into task-, phase-, action-, boundary-, and fixed-session-shaped stacks by changing mappings and stack fields?
sufficiency_rows.core_experiment: E1: coverage, recursive folding, and field derivation
sufficiency_rows.failure_interpretation: If stack depth cannot change without changing operation input, the two-abstraction model collapses back into fixed prompt/session/tool objects.
sufficiency_rows.figure_table_target: Table core-results plus dataset/coverage table; E1 is table-first because the key claim is coverage and foldability rather than a ranking curve.
sufficiency_rows.negative_or_scope_condition: This supports configurable operation-stack folding, not complete ecosystem compatibility or automatic latent-intent recovery.
sufficiency_rows.oracle: Public dataset labels and native trajectory fields; OSWorld-Human and AgentNet provide the strongest boundary and quality labels.
sufficiency_rows.primary_experiment: R286 recursive stack-depth sweep, with R342 profile-spec composition and R353 trace exchange as support.
sufficiency_rows.primary_metrics: operation coverage, unique-stack range across depths, mapping compression/reduction, boundary F1/V-measure, prompt/session-free profile-spec replay, and trace round-trip equality.
sufficiency_rows.success_criterion: The same operation input folds across depths (9->3757 stacks), profile specs stay prompt/session-free (12/12), and standard-trace import/export preserves 512 samples and 11 stacks.

sufficiency_rows.baselines: flat summary, fixed-session drilldown/span-tree proxy, dataset-native hierarchy, raw-action stack, operation-stack width, operation-stack query-aware, label drilldown, and oracle upper bound.
sufficiency_rows.claim_gate_decision: Supported as a hidden-label profiler benchmark with baseline tradeoffs, not human utility.
sufficiency_rows.claim_test: Do hot stacks and top-ranked groups correspond to hidden positives while requiring less inspection work than flat summaries and less fragmentation than fixed-session drilldown used as a span-tree proxy?
sufficiency_rows.failure_interpretation: If flat, fixed-session, or dataset-native views dominate the Pareto frontier, the claim narrows to a visualization option rather than a profiler-localization method.
sufficiency_rows.figure_table_target: R363 baseline-tradeoff.svg, metric-heatmap.svg, and oracle-depth-adequacy.svg; Table R320 accuracy and Table core-results.
sufficiency_rows.negative_or_scope_condition: Flat and dataset-native views can win broad-recall or nDCG-style objectives; the claim is Pareto tradeoff, not metric dominance. Query-aware ranking is a visible task-query heuristic/tuning surface, not a universal label-free ranker.
sufficiency_rows.oracle: 3699 hidden positives over 34539 operations from 6 oracle-backed tasks and 4 datasets.
sufficiency_rows.primary_experiment: R320 hidden-label profile accuracy, with R333/R334/R355 budget, fragmentation, and oracle-depth slices.
sufficiency_rows.primary_metrics: AP/AUPRC-style score, precision@k, recall@k, F1@k, nDCG, recall/F1@work budget, top-k work, work-to-first-positive, group count, and oracle-depth unit recall.
sufficiency_rows.success_criterion: Operation-stack task-query ranking uses 0.0937 top-5 work vs 1.0 flat, beats fixed-session drilldown top-5 recall on 5/6 tasks, reduces median groups from 285.0 to 157.5, and beats fixed-session budget-30 unit recall on 20/24 oracle-depth rows.

sufficiency_rows.baselines: default semantic-width specs, patched profile specs, visible feature rankers, equal/global/transfer policies, learned-boundary stacks, fixed-session stacks, and semantic-width stacks.
sufficiency_rows.claim_gate_decision: Supported as actionable profile-spec and field/ranker guidance, not an automatic selector or boundary detector.
sufficiency_rows.claim_test: Which mechanisms explain localization improvements, and can profile-guided changes improve outputs without leaking hidden labels into the profiler input?
sufficiency_rows.failure_interpretation: If profile-guided specs or boundary-derived fields do not improve scored groups, the profiler gives descriptions but not actionable optimization knobs.
sufficiency_rows.figure_table_target: R363 diagnostic-lenses.svg and actionability-knobs.svg; actionability table and E3 row in Table core-results.
sufficiency_rows.negative_or_scope_condition: OSWorld-Human needs boundary-derived fields; learned-boundary folding increases top-5 work by 0.0813 and first-positive work by 0.1581, so this is not automatic boundary discovery or a universal selector. R358 is a supervised held-out boundary-field ablation, not unsupervised boundary discovery.
sufficiency_rows.oracle: The same hidden labels are used only after profiling for scoring; R358 additionally uses held-out OSWorld-Human boundary positives after learned boundary fields are visible operation fields.
sufficiency_rows.primary_experiment: R354 executable profile-spec patches, with R358 boundary-derived-field ablation for the OSWorld-Human rejection.
sufficiency_rows.primary_metrics: accepted patches, AP delta, top-5 lift delta, first-positive-work delta, group reduction, top-5 work counterpoint, and held-out transfer tolerance.
sufficiency_rows.success_criterion: R354 accepts 5/6 patches with median AP delta 0.0376 and top-5 lift delta 0.5750; R358 improves held-out OSWorld-Human AP from 0.2402 to 0.2583 and groups from 108 to 74 using supervised boundary-derived fields as visible operation fields.

sufficiency_rows.baselines: deterministic versus raw replay, source-status checks, paper-number checks, rubric checks, reviewer acceptance checks, and two-abstraction guardrails.
sufficiency_rows.claim_gate_decision: Supported as reproducible offline profiling-paper evidence, not live overhead or complete trace-ecosystem compatibility.
sufficiency_rows.claim_test: Can reviewers rerun the profile-spec path and verify that paper numbers, source provenance, two-abstraction wording, and non-claims remain aligned?
sufficiency_rows.core_experiment: E4: reproducibility, cost, and claim integrity
sufficiency_rows.failure_interpretation: If number, source, or guardrail gates fail, the paper can discuss a prototype but not claim reproducible profiling-paper evidence.
sufficiency_rows.figure_table_target: Reproducibility and claim-integrity table; source-status CSVs; E4 row in Table core-results.
sufficiency_rows.negative_or_scope_condition: This is offline artifact reproducibility, not live eBPF overhead, full OpenTelemetry/Phoenix/LangSmith/Langfuse/Perfetto compatibility, or human productivity evidence.
sufficiency_rows.oracle: Tracked profile specs, tracked operation inputs, paper/doc hashes, claim-integrity audits, and four independent reviewer-style acceptance checks.
sufficiency_rows.primary_experiment: R328 deterministic replay plus R338/R352/R356/R357/R359/R360/R361/R363 claim and paper-structure gates.
sufficiency_rows.primary_metrics: deterministic spec pass rate, profiler invocations, median/p95 runtime, number-check pass rate, guardrail pass rate, rubric level, reviewer ACCEPT count, and core-table checks.
sufficiency_rows.success_criterion: R338 passes 350/350 number checks and 16/16 guardrails; R356 passes 69/69 number checks; R352 is level_4_scoped_profile_benchmark; R357 records 4/4 reviewer accepts; R363 generates 5 paper views.
